reasoning.Student A: The mechanism is strategy-proof, so reporting my true ranking is a dominant strategy — I cannot improve my outcome by misrepresenting preferences regardless of what others do. My true preference ordering is z > x > w > y. Although many applicants favor y > x > w > z, and I have top priority at w and y (w:1, y:1) and lower priority at x and z (x:2, z:2), that does not change the fact that truth-telling is optimal under the stated mechanism. Ranking y higher to try to secure it would misrepresent my values and could only make me worse off (or at best no better off). Therefore I will submit my sincere preference: z > x > w > y.
